<div class="card-body">
'''Hoth''' is a [[Light]] [[Location]] ([[System]]) from [[Hoth (Japanese)|Hoth (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">＊ホス</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
'''Light Side:''' <span lang="ja">ここを支配しているなら、ここにいる自分の宇宙船１隻につき、ホスの位置での戦闘時に、合計戦闘力に＋１。</span>

'''Dark Side:''' <span lang="ja">ここを支配しているなら、ここにいる自分の宇宙船１隻につき、ホスの位置での戦闘時に、合計戦闘力に＋１。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Hoth-Hoth-Light-PSA-148375104.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Hoth.

'''Light Side:'''
If you control, for each of your starships here, your total power is +1 in battles at Hoth sites.

'''Dark Side:'''
If you control, for each of your starships here, your total power is +1 in battles at Hoth sites.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Hoth (Light)|Hoth]] in [[Hoth (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 43, 103. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
